which is owner-ratified and authoritative. Keep the two in step.
`ink` and `lovable` are full URLs. `treatment` is A / B / C per README.md §4.6.
`auth` names a storageState file under tmp/fidelity-auth/ when the row needs a session.
`expect` selectors abort the capture rather than writing an empty file (A3).
Rows 19, 20 and 21 are SKIPPED by owner ruling and are absent.
INK URLs must survive a refresh from prod: real migrated content, never a fixture.
A row may carry "lookup": the slug in its INK URL is found on the running site, never typed in. The lookup definitions
(round with / without results, newest, second-newest and oldest InkPols issue, Lovable's results slug) and the full gate
list (pages, states, viewports, maps) are in tools/fidelity/accept/gates.json; "gate" names the group that runs the row.
`bases.lovable` is the default preview URL. Override with LOVABLE_URL or "lovablePreview" in tools/local.config.json if
